subject: Request: Cross-region POC safety escrow for weekend ramp
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha@relayretail.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekend ramp: cross-region soak + request for credits and short trial extension

Hi Jonas,

Quick one — we have a cross-region soak planned this weekend (US daytime -> EU overnight) to validate latency and throughput for our new recommendation pipeline. The team wants to run a staggered ramp to simulate real traffic (peak ~4k rps sustained for 45m, target p95 < 240ms).

We're still on the trial account and are likely to blow through the current allowance during the test. Could Redwood provision a temporary credit escrow just for the weekend so we can run the full workload? Ideally: enough headroom for ~1.2M tokens (rough estimate) and a short extension of the trial window through July 5 so the operations team can collect telemetry and replay logs.

I've attached our POC plan and a throughput curve to help size the request. Happy to hop on a 15m call if you need more context — we're in PST but have engineers in London and Bangalore who will be on the run.

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Head of Platform Engineering
Relay Retail

Attachments: poc-plan.xlsx (sheet: weekend-schedule), throughput-curve.png

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Weekend ramp: cross-region soak + request for credits and short trial extension

Camila / Marissa — forwarding Relay Retail's ask. Key points: weekend cross-region soak, estimated 1.2M tokens, need credits escrow + trial extension to 2027-07-05. They'll run staggered windows to cover US/EU/APAC handoffs.

Questions for approval:
- Provisional credit amount: authorize up to $1,200 equivalent in trial credits? (we typically estimate $0.001/token for budgeting here but can adjust)
- Condition: require SOC2 confirmation / no long-term retention of PII during soak (see CC Soojin)
- Duration: credits valid only for 2027-07-02 00:00 UTC through 2027-07-04 23:59 UTC

I can confirm we have capacity in the US and EU pools; we'll route to EU variant if EU latency spikes. If approved, I'll respond to Aisha with the top-up and extension and attach the promotional T&Cs.

-Jonas

On Mon, 28 Jun 2027 at 09:12 Aisha Khan <aisha@relayretail.com> wrote:
> Quick one — we have a cross-region soak planned this weekend (US daytime -> EU overnight) to validate latency and throughput for our new recommendation pipeline...

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Weekend ramp: cross-region soak + request for credits and short trial extension

Thanks for the summary, Jonas. Approve provisional credit escrow with conditions below:

1) Allocate up to $1,000 in trial credits to Relay Retail, earmarked and refundable to our promo pool if not fully consumed.
2) Credits are strictly valid for the weekend window you proposed (2027-07-02 00:00 UTC -> 2027-07-04 23:59 UTC). No carry-forward.
3) Soojin — please confirm SOC2 / data-handling checklist is met before we provision. If there are open items, release is contingent on a signed attestation (short form) from Relay.
4) Tie the release to a HubSpot task and record the deal as a promotional allocation (I'll add the HubSpot note).

Ben, please confirm budget code for the promo pool and mark as "weekend-escrow-REL-0627". Marissa, once Soojin signs off, please handle the actual top-up and update the customer with the extension date and the DocuSign link for T&Cs.

Camila
VP, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced by customer: poc-plan.xlsx, throughput-curve.png

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Weekend ramp: cross-region soak + request for credits and short trial extension

Quick security check: relay's team must confirm the following before credits go live:
- No production PII will be sent to Redwood during the soak (hashed/anonymized traces only).
- Retention: any request logs used for replay must be deleted within 7 days post-test unless agreed in writing.
- SOC2 evidence: I've attached our SOC2 summary (soc2-evidence-request.pdf) for their reference and asked them to return the checklist.

If Relay returns the checklist as "green" by EOD 2027-06-30, I'm good to greenlight. Also suggest we enable short-term verbose telemetry capture for the weekend window (30m granularity) and alerting on p95 thresholds. Marissa — can we enable a temporary telemetry retention in the console for the account ID once approved?

-Soojin

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha@relayretail.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekend ramp: cross-region soak + request for credits and short trial extension

Hi Aisha — quick update and next steps.

1) We've provisionally approved a $1,000 trial credit escrow for Relay Retail, earmarked for your weekend soak (2027-07-02 -> 2027-07-04). The credits will be activated once you return the short security checklist (see attached SOC2 summary).
2) We've extended your trial window to 2027-07-05 to allow for post-run telemetry capture.
3) Marissa will perform the top-up and enable 30m telemetry retention for the account; Ben has confirmed budget code (weekend-escrow-REL-0627).
4) Please sign the quick promotional T&C via DocuSign (link below) — this is standard for short-term promotional credits. We will not bill usage beyond the escrowed $1,000 without explicit approval.

HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 (Relay Retail / promo allocation)
DocuSign (promotional T&Cs): https://docusign.redwood.com/REL-0627-promo

If you can return the security checklist by 2027-06-30 EOD (your timezone), we'll push the credits live first thing on 2027-07-02 morning PST. Happy to set up a 15m sync if you'd like.

Thanks and looking forward to the run — good luck with the soak!

Jonas Weber
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
